description:
[EU ViDA real-time digital reporting & reverse charge auditor. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits cross-border B2B intra-community transactions under the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) Directive, verifying the mandatory 2-business-day issuance window, central VIES transmission requirements, and MTIC carousel fraud risk.
Usage: Use this tool to ensure intra-community supplies and cross-border services comply with upcoming EU DRR mandates.
Returns: JSON object with { invoiceNumber: string, isVidaCompliant: boolean, digitalReportingWindowHours: number, issuanceDeadlineCompliant: boolean, reportingMechanism: string, vatExemptionBasis: string, buyerVatReverseChargeMandate: boolean, mticCarouselFraudRisk: string }.

centralViesSyncTimestampIso.description: Optional timestamp of immediate VIES real-time registry check

customerCountryCode.description: 2-letter ISO country code of customer (e.g. DE)

supplierCountryCode.description: 2-letter ISO country code of supplier (e.g. IT)

taxableEventDateIso.description: Date goods were shipped or service completed (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: vida_cross_border_digital_reporter
